name: random_baseline_s143
hypothesis: A seeded random combination of allowed operators is used only as a control group; it does not encode an economic hypothesis.
economic_rationale: None. This baseline estimates how easily a mechanically generated expression can appear interesting on the same sample.
iteration_note: Seeded random control; not produced by an LLM.

name: Volume-Weighted Price Momentum with Trend Confirmation
hypothesis: Stocks with stronger recent volume-weighted price appreciation, confirmed by a shorter-term trend, tend to outperform over the medium horizon.
economic_rationale: Volume-weighted price captures the average price at which trading occurred, reflecting market consensus. Momentum with volume confirmation may indicate sustained demand and positive information diffusion, while the shorter-term trend filter avoids stocks with weakening price action.
expression: Rank((close - Delay(close, 20)) / Delay(close, 20) * (1 + (vwap - Delay(vwap, 20)) / Delay(vwap, 20)) * (close / Delay(close, 5) - 1))
risk_notes: Momentum crashes during market reversals or high volatility regimes.
The factor may be sensitive to liquidity and trading volume anomalies.
Short-term reversal effects could negate the trend confirmation component.
Crowding risk if many investors adopt similar momentum strategies.
Data quality issues with vwap calculation could distort the signal.
iteration_note: Initial proposal combining medium-term price momentum, volume-weighted price momentum, and a short-term trend filter. Future iterations may adjust lookback windows or introduce volatility scaling.

name: Volume-Weighted Price Momentum with Trend Confirmation (Revised)
hypothesis: Stocks with stronger recent volume-weighted price appreciation, confirmed by a shorter-term trend, tend to outperform over the medium horizon; simplifying to a cleaner, lower-turnover rank of volume-confirmed momentum may reduce noise relative to the multiplicative composite.
economic_rationale: Volume-weighted price captures the average transaction price and market consensus; combining medium-horizon price momentum with a volume-confirmed vwap momentum term preserves the demand-confirmation idea. The prior multiplicative construction mixed three noisy components and produced near-zero rank IC and negative realized returns on this sample, so the revision drops the short-term trend multiplier and shortens complexity to reduce turnover and noise, while retaining the same broad economic thesis.
risk_notes: Momentum crashes during market reversals or high volatility regimes.
Rank IC was weak on the prior sample; any revision remains in-sample and may overfit.
Dropping the trend filter may increase exposure to short-term reversals.
vwap data quality and liquidity anomalies could distort the signal.
iteration_note: Revised once from measured feedback: removed the short-term trend multiplier and simplified to an additive rank of 20-day close momentum plus 20-day vwap momentum, aiming to reduce turnover and composite noise; not yet re-evaluated, so no improvement is claimed.
